subject: Packaging options for audit logs + KMS/HSM — proposal and pilot concessions
messages:
From: Aisha Mohammed <aisha.mohammed@curapoint.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@curapoint.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-10T09:14:00Z
Subject: Inquiry — audit log retention tiers, HSM licensing & pilot concession

Hi Jonas / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and the residency options. Procurement & security surfaced a few items we need clarity on to push finance:

- Audit log retention: we need 7 years for a subset of accounts, with tiered access and export window. Can you confirm retention tiers and archival pricing?
- KMS vs HSM: we need an economic comparison for pilot vs GA (one-time HSM seat vs per-throughput).
- Implementation credits: legal asked if Redwood can offset onboarding fees during a 6-month pilot; they'd prefer a credit applied if we convert to annual.

Attaching a short RFP stub. TL;DR — we want a clear packaging option that doesn't double-bill audit storage + egress during evidence pulls.

Could you send an outline with 2–3 packaging paths (pilot-friendly + enterprise commit)? Also include how you treat auditlog surge (e.g., spikes during incident investigations) — do you offer temporary credits or burst pricing?

Thanks,
Aisha Mohammed
Head of Procurement, CuraPoint
Aisha.Mohammed@curapoint.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: Curapoint_RFP_stub.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Mohammed <aisha.mohammed@curapoint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Inquiry — audit log retention tiers, HSM licensing & pilot concession

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. I looped in Ben (pricing) and Laura (onboarding ops). Drafted three packaging paths below to keep options simple:

1) Pilot-first (6 months)
  - Audit logs: 90-day hot retention included, cold archive to S3-compatible storage billed at $0.XX/GB/month. 7-year archival available as a tiered add-on (we can amortize implementation).
  - KMS: managed KMS (no extra seat fee) for pilot. HSM seat (customer-provisioned) only at conversion; propose deferring HSM seat charge until day 91 of annual commitment.
  - Surge handling: first two incident investigations/month covered; additional surges billed at discounted burst rate.

2) Committed enterprise (12/24 mo)
  - Audit logs: choose 1/3/7yr retention rings with volume breakpoints; enterprise package bundles audit-storage + retrieval credits.
  - HSM: option for HSM-seat licensing (one-time) or throughput slab (monthly). We recommend throughput slab for higher throughput customers.
  - Credit: 10% recurring-addon discount with a 12mo commit; implementation fee offset applied as a credit over first 6 months.

3) Hybrid (staged residency)
  - Mix of managed KMS for non-sensitive workloads + HSM for regulated datasets. Auditlog routing by dataset; cross-charge model documented.
  - We can propose a blended unit price to simplify procurement.

I've attached a short workbook with line items (RI_proposal_kms_hsm_options.xlsx). Ben — can you populate the per-GB and seat costs and a sample econ for a 100k monthly event volume?

Next step: Aisha — if one of these maps cleanly, we can prepare a short addendum that addresses 7-year retention evidence delivery + a draft concession for pilot conversion.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: RI_proposal_kms_hsm_options.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Aisha Mohammed <aisha.mohammed@curapoint.com>

Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@curapoint.com>, procurement@curapoint.com
Date: 2028-04-12T11:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Inquiry — audit log retention tiers, HSM licensing & pilot concession

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A few clarifications from security & legal after reviewing the workbook: 

- Retrieval credits: we need guaranteed discounted retrievals for compliance audits (min 4/year) — can these be contractually capped at X retrievals/year at a fixed rate?
- HSM seat: legal prefers a pass-through license model or evidence that seat can transfer if we migrate nodes.
- Pilot conversion: procurement asked for the onboarding fee to be waived if we sign a 24-month enterprise agreement within 90 days of pilot end.

Liam also attached a redline to standard T&Cs (see redline_terms_curapoint.docx). Is Redwood open to a firm commitment on retrieval caps + a conditional waiver of the onboarding fee?

Also, can you confirm whether auditlog exports include an integrity hash and time-synced stamps? Security will want that documented in the addendum.

We can jump on a 30-min sync if easier — availability Tuesday/Wednesday next week.

Best,
Aisha

Attachment: redline_terms_curapoint.docx (docx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-14T16:28:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Inquiry — audit log retention tiers, HSM licensing & pilot concession (internal counter)

Ben / Laura — forwarding Aisha's latest. My suggested counter to present tomorrow:

- Retrieval cap: offer "Compliance Retrieval Bundle" — 4 retrievals/year at fixed $X per retrieval for 7yr-retained logs. Additional retrievals billed at 40% off list. Include integrity hash + timestamping in SOW.
- HSM economics: propose two options in the SOW: (A) one-time HSM seat ($Y) with transfer clause, or (B) monthly throughput slab (preferred for high-volume). For the pilot, waive seat fee and include managed KMS; if they convert to >=12mo within 90 days, apply a credit equal to 50% of the seat fee against first two invoices.
- Onboarding fee: offer full waiver only on 24mo closed-won within 60 days of pilot end; if they sign 12mo within 90 days, offer 50% waiver.
- Auditlog surge: include first two incident surges/month free, and an "incident cushion" of 250GB/year at no charge for the first contract year.

I recommend we hold firm on the 24mo-for-full-waiver ask but be flexible for 12mo. This keeps commercial upside while addressing procurement's ask.

Ben — can you run numbers on the margin impact and provide finalized per-unit figures? Laura — prepare a short SOW appendix referencing integrity hash and retrieval SLA. I can take Aisha up on the 30-min sync once we have numbers.

— Jonas
